test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The bar graph given below shows sales of table fans (in thousand numbers) from five showrooms during two consecutive years 2021 and 2022. The total sales of showroom B for both years is what per cent of the total sales of showroom E for both years? (Rounded off to 2 decimal places)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/247e9e3a288d241ad4fa003dd25b48954ab48eb126b15209ee0acb33e2e7d09d.png]
solution:
**Given:**

Showroom B sales:

2021: 85

2022: 70

Total sales of B = 85 + 70 = 155

Showroom E sales:

2021: 90

2022: 105

Total sales of E = 90 + 105 = 195

**Formula used:**

Percentage = (Total sales of B / Total sales of E) × 100

**Calculation:**

Percentage = (155 / 195) × 100 = 79.49%

**∴ The total sales of showroom B for both years is 0.7949 of the total sales of showroom E for both years.**
